title: Junior Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description :

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.

Mitchell is looking for a Data Scientist to identify and deliver AI/ML opportunities across our product portfolio. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to turn business problems into working solutions — including generative AI and large language models (LLMs).

Responsibilities:

Identify AI/ML opportunities across products and support implementation efforts.
Design and test prompts for LLM-based generative AI features.
Build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models in production.
Partner with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to solve business problems with ML.
Follow and contribute to best practices for ML pipelines, model monitoring, and deployment.
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You are a motivated self-starter who can work through ambiguous problems with minimal direction. You bring:

Strong analytical skills and solid knowledge of ML methodologies, data engineering, and feature engineering.
Ability to collaborate with engineering teams on scalable ML pipelines and established standards.
Clear communication skills — comfortable presenting to non-technical stakeholders and sharing knowledge across teams.
A habit of staying current with ML research through papers, blogs, and open-source projects.

Qualifications:
MS or PhD in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
MS: 2 years of professional ML experience
PhD: 1+ years of professional ML experience
2+ years of experience building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in production.
Hands-on experience with data warehouses, feature engineering, ML pipeline automation, and model monitoring.
Solid knowledge of ML algorithms and techniques, with the ability to explain core concepts clearly.
High proficiency in Python and SQL.
Good understanding of data warehousing and ETL processes.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Nice to have: Experience with AWS SageMaker.
Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $85,000 - $100,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Junior Software Engineer - AI Quality & Testing
jobDescription:
Junior Software Engineer - AI Quality & Testing is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer-facing AI outputs against real-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap.

Why this role matters

Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would.

Responsibilities
Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Junior Software Engineer - AI Quality & Testing assignments.
Grade junior software engineer ai quality testing engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge-case handling.
Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed.
Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric.
Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off-by-one, security issue) with severity scores.
Document recurring code-generation failures so the modeling team can target them.
Calibrate against gold-standard reviews to keep inter-rater agreement above target.
Qualifications
Strong day-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Junior Software Engineer - AI Quality & Testing work.
Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode.
Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use.
Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer.
Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.
Prior code-review or technical-interview-grading experience is a plus.
Example tasks
Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it.
Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge-case bug.
Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric.
Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced.
Nice to have
Open-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production-quality code.
Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides.
Familiarity with security-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns.
Skills
Code review
Debugging
Unit testing
Software engineering judgment
Junior Software Engineer AI Quality Testing engineering review
Quality Engineering
Typescript
Video Generator
Work model

Remote — US-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US.

Compensation

$30–$42 / hr

Application process

Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

title: Junior .NET Developer
jobDescription:
Junior .NET Developer

About Blue Rose Consulting Group

Blue Rose Consulting Group is a mission-driven federal contractor dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that support our clients and the communities they serve.

People First. Mission Always.

We believe exceptional outcomes start with exceptional people. We are committed to building collaborative teams where talented professionals can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

About the Role

Blue Rose Consulting Group is seeking a Junior .NET Developer to support a large-scale .NET application within a national security environment. This role will contribute to software development efforts involving data analysis, reconciliation and consolidation, reporting, user interface development, mobile application development, and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD).

The Junior .NET Developer will work collaboratively with technical teams supporting highly available national security systems and contribute to the development and delivery of reliable software solutions.

This position requires U.S. citizenship and an active Final DoD Secret security clearance.

Key Responsibilities

Support the development and maintenance of a large-scale .NET application.
Perform data analysis, reconciliation, and consolidation activities.
Support multi-source data integration and deduplication.
Analyze trends and patterns within complex datasets.
Develop queries and reporting solutions.
Contribute to user interface design and development.
Support mobile application development.
Participate in CI/CD processes and software delivery activities.
Collaborate with technical teams supporting highly available national security systems.

Minimum Qualifications

U.S. Citizen.
Active Final DoD Secret security clearance.
2+ years of experience supporting complex technical projects, including work with highly available national security systems.
Experience with data analysis and reconciliation.
Experience with multi-source data integration and deduplication.
Experience analyzing trends and patterns and developing queries and reports.
Experience with user interface design and development.
Hands-on working knowledge of the .NET Framework.
Hands-on working knowledge of SQL Server.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting a large-scale federal IT program.
Experience working within the SAFe Agile delivery framework.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role requires a developer who can contribute effectively within an established technical environment while continuing to build their development expertise. The ideal candidate is collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex data and software systems supporting mission-critical operations.

Key indicators of success include:

Producing accurate and reliable development work.
Effectively analyzing and working with data from multiple sources.
Collaborating successfully with technical team members.
Contributing to software development and delivery activities within established processes.
Demonstrating attention to detail, accountability, and a commitment to supporting mission requirements.

title: Junior Software QA Tester
jobDescription:
Junior Software QA Tester

Location: Remote, based within approximately 1.5 hours of Mooresville, NC or the surrounding area. Must be able to drive to the client site once a month. Type: Full-Time Department: Managed Application Services | Years of experience: 1 to 3 | Salary: $50k to $70k | Job type: Remote with 20% travel

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented Software QA Tester to join our Managed Application Services team. In this role, you'll test custom applications that our development team builds and deploys across our clients' businesses. These applications integrate closely with our clients systems, so you'll need to be comfortable learning how our clients' operations, processes, and business rules actually work in order to test effectively.

This is a great fit for someone who's naturally curious, methodical, and not satisfied until they've found the edge case everyone else missed.

What You'll Do
Write clear, thorough test plans and test cases based on application requirements and client business rules
Execute manual (and where applicable, automated) testing across web and desktop applications
Identify, document, and track software bugs and defects through resolution
Learn client’s operations and workflows well enough to test software in real-world context
Validate that applications correctly integrate with and reflect data from client systems
Collaborate closely with developers, project managers, and client stakeholders to clarify requirements and confirm fixes
Perform regression testing to ensure new releases don't break existing functionality
Communicate testing status, risks, and issues clearly to the project team
Train end users on how to use our software solutions
What You Bring
Experience writing test plans, test cases, and bug reports
Solid understanding of QA methodologies and the software testing lifecycle
Familiarity with Microsoft technologies (e.g., .NET, SQL Server, Windows Server, Azure)
Ability to quickly learn new business domains — manufacturing experience or exposure to ERP systems is a strong plus
Strong analytical skills and an eye for detail
Clear written and verbal communication skills
Comfort working directly with client-facing teams to understand real business processes
Nice to Have
Associate or bachelors in a technology related field
Experience testing applications integrated with ERP platforms (e.g., Dynamics, SAP, Epicor, etc.)
Exposure to automated testing tools or frameworks
Prior experience in a managed services or software consulting environment

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

Junior-level, but highly detail-oriented and methodical, with a natural instinct to think outside the box
Comfortable with technology and how software works, without needing deep technical or coding depth
Genuinely content with steady, repetitive day-to-day work; this role rewards consistency over novelty
Comfortable taking an adversarial approach to testing
Willing to visit the client's plant once a month to understand how the software drives production and runs the business
Able to communicate clearly and comfortably with non-technical end users on the plant floor
People with business analyst instincts, or prior business analyst experience, tend to be a strong fit
Comfortable with a break/fix support model and mindset
Why Join Us

You'll play a critical role in making sure the applications we build actually work for the organizations who depend on them every day, catching issues before they hit the production systems. You'll get exposure to a variety of client environments, and industries such as manufacturing, healthcare, transportation etc. and the full lifecycle of custom application development.

Who is Biz Technology Solutions, a New Charter Company?

We are an established Information Technology company headquartered in the Charlotte NC area. We partner with small to medium size businesses to manage, support, and streamline their IT so they can focus on running their business. What sets us apart from other IT providers is our operational maturity, our culture and credibility in the marketplace.

Why BTS?

While work is important, we also understand a work/life balance and corporate culture are critical to having happy employees! Our average employee tenure is 7 years. Some of the perks you will receive as a BTS employee:

Great medical insurance plans.

Work from home flexibility

RTO - With Responsible Time Off, you’re trusted to take the time you need to recharge with most of our team asking about 3 weeks off each year.

Paid gym memberships

On premises fully stocked snack bar, gym, meditation space, and gaming area

Fleet of corporate vehicles to drive

Social committee to plan social events

Family oriented company culture with a good work/life balance

Monthly catered breakfasts/lunches

Paid certifications and training

Career path

Vision and dental insurance

401K

Biz Technology Solutions, a New Charter Company, is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Biz Technology Solutions recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Jr .Net Developer
jobDescription:
Location: 100% remote.

Years’ Experience: 2+ years professional development experience.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering or IT related field.

Clearance: Applicants must currently possess an active Secret security clearance or higher-level security clearance. United States Citizenship is required as part of the eligibility criteria to be able to obtain this type of security clearance.

Key Skills:

• Software development experience using C# and .NET 8.0.
• Experience developing and maintaining web applications using Blazor and JavaScript.
• Experience with front-end technologies such as Bootstrap and React.js.

Responsibilities

• Develop, enhance, test, and maintain web applications using C# and .NET 8.0, supporting new functionality, application improvements, and ongoing maintenance across multiple applications.
• Develop and maintain user interfaces using Blazor, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and React.js, with a focus on functionality, usability, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
• Implement and maintain application functionality across frontend and backend components, ensuring reliable integration between user interfaces, application services, and databases.
• Integrate and maintain REST APIs and other application interfaces, troubleshoot integration issues, and assess the impact of changes to external APIs and dependent services.
• Integrate front-end applications with AWS services.
• Ensure application performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
• Develop and maintain application queries and database interactions with Oracle, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliable application functionality. Collaborate with database administrators on complex queries and database-related issues as needed.
• Investigate, diagnose, and resolve application defects and production issues, with particular attention to frontend functionality, application behavior, and system integrations.
• Develop and execute unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and follow established coding standards and version control practices to maintain application quality and reliability.
• Identify and resolve application performance issues, improve application responsiveness, and support the stability and reliability of production applications.
• Follow established secure coding practices and applicable program security requirements when developing, modifying, and maintaining applications that support U.S. Navy missions.
• Document application changes and technical solutions, collaborate with developers, system engineers, database administrators, and other technical team members, and support the investigation and resolution of cross-system issues.
• Collaborate with site reliability engineering and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot application issues in Kubernetes-based environments, as needed.

Qualifications

• 2+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on development using C# and .NET.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Active Secret security clearance.
• Hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using C# and .NET 8.0.
• Experience developing and maintaining web applications using Blazor and JavaScript.
• Experience with front-end technologies such as Bootstrap and React.js.
• Experience integrating and troubleshooting REST APIs and application interfaces.
• Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate application defects and resolve production issues.
• Ability to work collaboratively with developers, database administrators, system engineers, and other technical stakeholders.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical changes and communicate issues and solutions effectively.

About Sparibis

Sparibis LLC is a professional solution firm that Clients rely on to access the best talent to drive their business success.

Sparibis is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.
